prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1318; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this office now represents our client in connection with a collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection and was struck by another vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Effective immediately, all communication regarding this claim should be directed exclusively to this office. Please do not contact our client directly, by telephone, mail, or in person.

We also request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including all liability coverage limits that apply to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this collision.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, telematics information, recorded statements, claim file notes, and any repair or inspection records. Please ensure that this material is not altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
